tasks.title: Conversation #87
tasks.transcript:
Woman: There's a lot of buzz about the new Italian restaurant downtown, though the reviews are decidedly mixed.
Man: One of my neighbors said his pasta was seasoned to perfection, while another thought they overdid it with the olive oil.
Woman: Maybe we should figure it out for ourselves. How about this Saturday? I could make a reservation.
Man: That day? I have some family members coming over to my house for dinner. Sorry.

questions.stem: Why does the man mention his neighbors?

options.A: To confirm that customers disagree about a restaurant
options.B: To imply that some people do not like Italian food
options.C: To emphasize the importance of olive oil in Italian food
options.D: To identify the people that visited a restaurant with him

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：男士为什么提到他的邻居？ 定位原文：Man: One of my neighbors said his pasta was seasoned to perfection, while another thought they overdid it with the olive oil. 选项分析： A. To confirm that customers disagree about a restaurant 为了证实顾客对一家餐厅意见不一。男士举出两个邻居对同一家意大利菜截然不同的评价（一个说调味完美，另一个说橄榄油过多），正好呼应了女士说的“reviews are decidedly mixed”，所以A选项正确。 B. To imply that some people do not like Italian food 为了暗示有些人不喜欢意大利菜。对话中没有提到邻居不喜欢意大利菜，只是对菜品做法有不同看法，所以B选项错误。 C. To emphasize the importance of olive oil in Italian food 为了强调橄榄油在意大利菜中的重要性。男士只是在举例说明评价不同，并非强调橄榄油本身的重要性，所以C选项错误。 D. To identify the people that visited a restaurant with him 为了指认和他一起去过餐厅的人。男士没有说他和邻居一起去过，只是转述邻居的评价，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Why does the man mention his family members?

options.A: To make a point about an existing reservation
options.B: To point out a different opinion about a restaurant
options.C: To invite the woman to his house for dinner

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：男士为什么提到他的家人？ 定位原文：Woman: How about this Saturday? I could make a reservation. Man: That day? I have some family members coming over to my house for dinner. Sorry. 选项分析： A. To make a point about an existing reservation 为了说明一个已有的预约。男士没有提到自己有预约，只是说家人要来，所以A选项错误。 B. To point out a different opinion about a restaurant 为了指出对餐厅的不同看法。家人话题与对餐厅的看法无关，所以B选项错误。 C. To invite the woman to his house for dinner 为了邀请女士去他家吃饭。男士只是说家人来吃饭，并没有邀请女士参加，所以C选项错误。 D. To decline the woman's invitation 为了拒绝女士的邀请。女士提议周六去餐厅并说可以预约，男士以家人来家里吃饭为由回答“Sorry”，这是在委婉拒绝，所以D选项正确。
